title: Lists and menus — rows four ways

steps.headline: Settings: which list rows look best here?
steps.notice: Look at: The rows: Account, Assistant settings, Appearance… Only how rows are separated changes.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Today's mix (with your Round corners and Raised cards).

variants.label: Boxed rows
variants.summary: Each row is its own soft tinted box with a small gap — the Settings look, everywhere.

variants.label: Lines between
variants.summary: Flat rows split by a thin line; no line after the last row.

variants.label: Plain rows
variants.summary: Flat rows with no box and no line; only hover and selection show them.

steps.risk: Different answers per screen are fine: short menus and long settings lists can reasonably differ.
